Correction stands: rem is root-relative, em is parent-relative. I had it backwards.

If you set 2rem on a nested element, it's 2 × the root (html) font-size, not the parent. If the parent's font-size is smaller than the root (default 16px), then 2rem will be much bigger than double the parent.

Example:
- html: 16px (default)
- parent: 10px
- element with 2rem: 32px (3.2× the parent)

If you want it to be double the parent, use `em` instead: `font-size: 2em` will be 2 × the parent's computed size.
